title: [SOLVED] I Need A Method To Show The Player The Game Controls Before They Begin A New Game

posts.author: BrysonUltra
posts.body:
I am looking for the easiest method to allow the player to see the game controls before they begin a new game.
This can be by showing a picture or by showing some text on the screen
I was able to add a
Settings
command to the title screen that connects to
Yanfly system options
thanks to the help of an experienced developer on Discord.
Example in image below
I'm open to suggestions.
I was currently hoping I could add a
Controls
command that displays an image showing default game controls.
It should provide the option for the player to return to the title screen.
Update: The problem has been solved, a dev from the discord was able to help solve the problem. Thank you to the people who replied here, you also offered good options.

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body:
There are scripts that show pictures before the title screen, and there're probably scripts that add a controls button to the title screen and menu. Depends which one you'd prefer.
But I find it easier to just ask/show the player the controls after pressing new game but before ask/showing the tutorial/intro. Also adding a key item to the player's inventory for if they want to view the controls again later.

Ace Master Script List

posts.author: Zeriab
posts.body:
Consider showing a picture once the player takes control after the initial cutscene. (Can be done in addition to what you want)
Finding Paradise for example shows a little picture to the lower-right.
I find it easier to remember the controls if they are shown when needed.
Looking at this I would probably also have added a new picture once the player moved which shows you how to pickup the machine in the car (interact button)
*hugs*
- Zeriab

module R2_Title_Controls
  Image = "keyboard"
  Position = 3 # before shutdown with system options
  Control_Text = "Controls"
end

# ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║                      End of editable region                        ║
# ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

class Scene_Title < Scene_Base
  alias :r2_create_control_image :create_command_window
  def create_command_window
    r2_create_control_image
    @command_window.set_handler(:controls, method(:command_controls))
  end
  def command_controls
    @control_sprite = Sprite.new
    @control_sprite.bitmap = Cache.picture(R2_Title_Controls::Image)
    @control_sprite.z = 200
  end
  def clear_pictures
    @control_sprite.bitmap.dispose
    @control_sprite.dispose
    @control_sprite = nil
    @command_window.activate
  end
  alias :r2_update_picture  :update
  def update
    if @control_sprite
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      clear_pictures if Input.trigger?(:B)
      return
    end
    r2_update_picture
  end
end

class Window_TitleCommand < Window_Command
  alias :r2_command_controls_list  :make_command_list
  def make_command_list
    r2_command_controls_list
    add_command(R2_Title_Controls::Control_Text, :controls)
    added = @list.pop
    @list.insert([R2_Title_Controls::Position, @list.size].min, added)
  end
end
